# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check if there are any other sentinel values besides -1
print(f"\nOther sentinel values in customer_age: {sales['customer_age'].unique()[sales['customer_age'].unique() != -1]}")

# Check the revenue column for formatting
print(f"\nFirst 5 revenue values: {sales['revenue'].head(5).tolist()}" )

# Check for the QA orders
print(f"\nNumber of rows with revenue == 999999.99: {sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0]}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"\nNumber of refunded orders: {sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]}")"}
